caseName: Town of Lockport v. Citizens for Community Action at the Local Level, Inc.
caseNameFull: Town of Lockport, New York v. Citizens for Community Action at the Local Level, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. W. D. N. Y. Judgment vacated and case remanded for reconsideration in light of the provisions of new charter adopted by Niagara County in 1974.
